title: Polar test form for a k-vector field: ∫⁻_B |κ| dμ ≤ ∫ κ(ω) dμ + ε with ω continuous, |ω| ≤ 1, tsupport ω ⊆ B
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on ℝ^N = Eucl N, κ : ℝ^N → Λ_k(ℝ^N) a field of k-vectors (NVector (Eucl N) k), R ∈ ℝ and B := ball(0, R). For γ ∈ SimonMultiIndex k N let κ^γ(x) := euclideanNVectorCoordinate (κ x) γ = κ(x)(dx^γ), where dx^γ := wedgeCovectors k (fun j ↦ EuclideanSpace.proj (γ j)), and assume that every κ^γ is μ-integrable on B. Then for every real ε > 0 there is ω : ℝ^N → Λ^k(ℝ^N) (Covector (Eucl N) k) such that ω is continuous, tsupport ω ⊆ B, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ 1 for every x, x ↦ κ(x)(ω(x)) is μ-integrable, and ∫⁻_B ENNReal.ofReal(√(Σ_γ κ^γ(x)²)) dμ(x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(∫ κ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) + ε).
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl N)) (κ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k) (R : ℝ), (∀ γ : SimonMultiIndex k N, IntegrableOn (fun x => euclideanNVectorCoordinate (κ x) γ) (ball (0 : Eucl N) R) μ) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ω : Eucl N → Covector (Eucl N) k, Continuous ω ∧ tsupport ω ⊆ ball (0 : Eucl N) R ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ 1) ∧ Integrable (fun x => κ x (ω x)) μ ∧ ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Eucl N) R, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (∑ γ : SimonMultiIndex k N, (euclideanNVectorCoordinate (κ x) γ) ^ 2)) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, κ x (ω x) ∂μ + ε)
